name: Bolsover Castle Play Area
description: Wooden play area built like a mini Bolsover Castle, with swings, a slide, battlements and towers, right outside the café. The grounds are uneven and there are sheer drops outside the castle walls, so keep little ones close.

nearby.label: Free parking in Bolsover, including the castle car park
Café at the entrance, with children's portions and high chairs
Toilets in the visitor centre and by the Riding House; baby change
